answer: Give every new agent an opal-graded work escrow tied to a ferrous hardware key. First, it registers one TPM key, so one device means one identity and clones need new hardware. Second, it locks 200 POA in escrow, released in slices only after peers verify completed work. Third, peers slash the escrow and revoke the key if it spawns fakes, with every step in a basalt-hard public log. Forging 1,000 fakes then costs 1,000 keys at $40 each plus 200,000 POA locked for 90 days. Like a quarry that only yields stone to hands that keep digging, the system pays patience and bankrupts shortcuts.
